Sandbox_AutoPilot_FirewoodLogsPerJob_too: Most logs and large branches chopped into firewood in one job
Sandbox_AutoPilot_EnableMacro_tooltip: Experimental. Players record or write a sequence of game actions (recipes, exercise, rest, food, drink, smoking) and have it repeated. Every step is an action as by hand, checked by the server. Off: nobody can use them. Changes apply at once, no restart
Sandbox_AutoPilot_MacroActionsPerRun_too: Most actions in one run of a macro (a recipe, an exercise set, a rest, a meal count one each); then the macro ends
Sandbox_AutoPilot_MacroLoopsPerRun_toolt: Most loops of all the "repeat" and "while" blocks in one run, "while True" too
Sandbox_AutoPilot_MacroActionsPerMinute_: Most actions a macro starts in one minute; past it, the macro waits. Against server lag
Sandbox_AutoPilot_EnableMacroBenches_too: Experimental, needs Macros too. Macros do the recipes of the workbenches (forge, furnace, pottery wheel, kiln, press...) as by hand: the character walks to the bench, marks it "in use" like the bench's window, does the recipe and leaves it at the end. A bench another player is using: the macro waits 30 seconds, then stops. Off: no macro uses the benches
Sandbox_AutoPilot_MacroBenchRadius_toolt: Most squares between the place where the macro starts and the bench it uses (same floor)
Sandbox_AutoPilot_MacroMinutesPerRun_too: Most real minutes of one run of a macro; then the macro ends. 0 = no limit
Sandbox_AutoPilot_MacroLevelsPerRun_tool: Most levels one skill gains in one run of a macro; then the macro ends. 0 = no limit
Sandbox_AutoPilot_MacroExcludedSkills_to: Skills no macro works for, the game's ids separated by semicolons (for example Reloading;Doctor). The macro stops before an action that would reward them. Empty: none
Sandbox_AutoPilot_EnableMacroTransfers_t: Experimental, needs Macros too. Macros take items from containers and put them in (take, put), drop them on the ground (drop), hold them (equip) and walk to a place (walk_to), with the game's own actions as by hand. The places are crates or squares the player marks with a click in the editor. Never favourite, held or worn items as cargo; locked containers and the safehouses the player may not use stay closed. Off: no macro moves items
Sandbox_AutoPilot_MacroItemsPerRun_toolt: Most items one run of a macro takes, puts, drops or holds; then the macro ends
Sandbox_AutoPilot_MacroPlaceRadius_toolt: Most squares between the place where the macro starts and a place it uses (another floor too). A place farther away: the macro does not start
Sandbox_AutoPilot_MacroEatNear: Macros: food and water within reach
Sandbox_AutoPilot_MacroEatNear_tooltip: Macros eat and drink (eat(), drink()) also from the containers within reach, the loot window's around the character: furniture, fridge, the floor next to them, a trunk. Never from corpses, locked crates or the safehouses the player may not use; what is left goes back where it was, as by hand. Off: only what the player carries. Changes apply at once, without a restart
